buyer_added_terms.text: ेेतताा ाारराा जजोोड़ड़ गगईई बबडड कक ववशशेषेष शशतत

1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The Security Agency should have a registered office in Keralam. Registration details to be provided . 2. The Security Agency shall provide necessary Uniforms, Shoes, Belts, Rain coats, Baton, Torch with cells, whistle etc. to the security guards deployed for duty. 3. The CMLRE has the right to increase or decrease the manpower at any point of time by giving one month notice time. The Agency shall not change any personnel without prior consent from CMLRE. 4. The security agency should have the capacity to provide additional manpower during functions/visi t of VVIPs. Additional charges will be settled as per the contract rates. 5. The security Guards provided by agency shall be employees of the Service provider and it shall be the duty of the service provider to pay their wages by 2n of every month. The agency shall comply with all statutory obligations under all related legislations as applicable to it from time to time and this office shall not incur any liability for any expenditure whatsoever on the persons employed by the Agency on account of any statutory obligations. 6. The security Agency personnel shall not divulge or disclose to any person, any details of office, ope rational process, technical know-how, security arrangements, administrative/ organizational matters. 7. The security Agency shall ensure proper conduct of his person in office premises, and enforce proh ibition of intoxicative substances during duty in CMLRE. The competent authority has the right to instruct t he agency for replacement, if found so. 8. Penalty @0.5% per week or part thereof of the contract value shall also be levied for failure to perf orm the contract satisfactorily subject to a maximum of 10% in the form of liqudated damages.This would be without prejudice other remedies available to the Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India. 9. The Agency should be registered under the ESI and Provident Fund Acts and other relevant statut ory enactments relating to the employment of labour. 10. The minimum wages to be paid to the security guards will be as per notification of Government/DG R. The Ministry of Earth Sciences/CMLRE will pay the Security Agency from time to time amounts notified b y the Government/DGR during the contract period. 11. The security Agency should furnish a security deposit as per instruction of the Government of India / guidelines of DGR. The security deposit will not accrue any interest and may be forfeited in the case of no n-compliance of the terms of agreement by the service provider or frequent absence/misconduct on part o f the security guard by the Agency. 12. Mode of payment will be on monthly basis. On receipt of monthly bill of the security guards provi ded, after verification of duties of the personnel and obtaining necessary financial approval of the Co mpetent Authority of CMLRE monthly payment will be released to the service provider through PFMS. Inc ome tax and TDS on GST shall be deducted at source as per the Income tax/GST Laws from the monthly bil ls. 13. CMLRE reserves the right to cancel the contract any time without giving any notice, whatsoever, if their services are not found to be satisfactory. If the agency want to terminate the contract the agency sho uld provide at least two month’s notice in writing. 14. ON award of contract, both the parties shall enter into an agreement with the relevant conditions in the contract and shall be signed by the Competent authorities. .
